english.title: Disclose confidential information regarding statement of reasons
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a relevant firm within the meaning of Part 6 of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021, failed to inform the Treasury, as soon as practicable, that it knew or had reasonable cause to suspect that a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(A)_[was a designated person,]_
(B)_[had committed an offence under Part 3 or regulation 22 of the Regulations,]_

the information or other matter upon which the knowledge or cause for suspicion was based come to it in the course of carrying on its business
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(1) and (6) and 31(3)(a) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
